title: newATTRSUB_x keeps using a CV that clear_special_blocks has already freed
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 1189b87114 (1189b87114b9d300ea13976c5b5227fea0c6e1c7) (2026-01-22). That commit is an ancestor of v5.45.3-85-gdb19522155 and is NOT an ancestor of the v5.36.3 tag (checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor, both directions), so it never reached the 5.36 maintenance branch; the pin's tree shows the unfixed code (pin op.c:12004 clear_special_blocks(name, gv, cv) called as void; op.c:11552 newATTRSUB_x keeps using cv). Host ASan at the pin: ASan: SEGV (rc=77); the same trigger, same harness and same ASan options on master: no report (rc=0, the harness reports [PASS])
fidelity: the trigger is the test upstream added with its own fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
